answer: Problem: Sybil clones flood attest markets with near-zero stake. Mechanism: each newcomer posts a copper bond equal to 2% of median peer stake, then must wander a 5-hop receipt path through a rotating garden of established graders who co-sign distinct work digests. Cost: bond locked 3 epochs; each hop burns 0.05% of bond. Verification: panel checks hop latency variance and digest uniqueness against the garden roster. Failure: broken path or repeated digests slash 30% of the copper bond and reset the wander counter.
